verdict.rationale: Slack's pricing page says every message, file, and conversation is saved and fully searchable with unlimited history, and the AI page repeats that anything shared in Slack is searchable. The MCP server also exposes search across Slack. However, nothing in the pack documents the sender, channel, or date filters the story asks for, nor any admin-specific search scope. Missing for 10: documented search filters by sender/channel/date, evidence of admin-level search across all conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
